parents.title: Specify shared versioned API, event envelope and module manifests
parents.acceptance: Versioned schemas, stable IDs, sequence, privacy and idempotency defined; [ASEL-1.0] ASEL gate: deterministic default-deny authorization and task-scoped least privilege apply outside the LLM; retrieved/model-generated content is untrusted data and cannot grant tools; secrets stay out of prompts, logs and artifacts; relevant scan/negative-test evidence is attached; unresolved Critical/High findings block completion; STOP/PAUSE/quota cannot be bypassed.
